title: Core Team Recruitment
body: We're building next year's council across all six teams. No experience required — we care about how you think, not what you already know.

title: GitHub Bootcamp
body: Git fundamentals through to pull requests, branching strategy and your first open-source contribution. Bring a laptop.

title: Kryptonex Hackathon
body: Twenty-four hours, open theme, teams of four. Mentors on the floor from every domain track.

title: Cybersecurity Lab
body: Hands-on session in a sanctioned lab environment — recon, web exploitation basics and how a SOC actually triages an alert.

title: Founder Meetup
body: An evening with founders who started while still on campus. Fundraising, first hires, and what they'd do differently.
